final_parent_mechanism.en: Use independent true transitions; only decision-changing residuals may update the world-model residual adapter while the policy remains frozen.

terminal_reason.zh: 严格服从人工 gate：需先与子龙确认 real continual-adaptation scenario、重做 novelty audit、精确定义 persistent update object；当前 repo 仅有 scenario-check，无确认记录。
terminal_reason.en: Strictly follows the human gate: first confirm a real continual-adaptation scenario with Zilong, rerun novelty audit, and precisely define the persistent update object; the repo contains only scenario-check and no confirmation record.

exact_stop.en: Stop if value-aware/CVAML or direct action-disagreement is equivalent, or if genuine decision-changing cases are too rare.

prior_terminal_reason.en: Strictly follows the human gate: first confirm a real continual-adaptation scenario with Zilong, rerun novelty audit, and precisely define the persistent update object; the repo contains only scenario-check and no confirmation record.

title.zh: 决策条件世界模型残差适配器

revival.changed_assumption: Use a localized residual adapter to a frozen world model; candidate transition errors matter only if correcting them changes frozen-policy action/value ordering.

strongest_baseline.en: Learn-all, residual-magnitude top-k, random equal-count, value-aware/CVAML-style weighting, and same-data direct action-disagreement selection.

pre_p0_gate.en: In exact-dynamics MDP/gridworld, decision-changing labels must not reduce to magnitude/value-aware scoring and must disagree on >=20% candidates versus the strongest baseline.

minimum_p0.en: Freeze a small world model+policy, collect >=100 transition errors with disjoint hidden state regions, update only the adapter, and use <=50% of learn-all transitions.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: action-changing and action-invariant residuals under a frozen policy

economy_contract.effect_observable: hidden action/value-order correction and downstream utility
economy_contract.effect_moderators: state region, action, residual type, policy margin
economy_contract.effect_stability_scope: unseen state regions under frozen policy
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: large error can be irrelevant while small error crosses an action margin
economy_contract.cheapest_falsifier: tabular/gridworld truth versus magnitude, value-aware, and direct selectors
economy_contract.abandonment_condition: value-aware/direct equivalence or insufficient action-changing support

final_parent_mechanism.en: Use predecessor deletion/substitution on failing counterfactuals to induce state-predicate -> forbidden-action/required-checkpoint clauses enforced by an external executor.

terminal_reason.zh: verified counterfactuals + simulator-off persistent memory 仍主要是 data generation/evaluation design，独立 method substance 不足。
terminal_reason.en: Verified counterfactuals plus simulator-off persistent memory remain primarily a data-generation/evaluation design with insufficient standalone method substance.

strongest_baseline.en: Same-label capacity-matched direct risk classifier/shield, hand irreversible mask, and nearest failed-trajectory memory with equal simulator calls and runtime checks.

exact_stop.en: Stop/merge into generic shielding if the same-capacity direct shield matches the held-out safety/false-block frontier or clauses require a stronger runtime oracle.

prior_terminal_reason.zh: verified counterfactuals + simulator-off persistent memory 仍主要是 data generation/evaluation design，独立 method substance 不足。
prior_terminal_reason.en: Verified counterfactuals plus simulator-off persistent memory remain primarily a data-generation/evaluation design with insufficient standalone method substance.

title.zh: 不可逆前置条件编译器

revival.changed_assumption: Counterfactual rollouts are supervision only; persist a typed precondition/constraint library that changes future action admissibility after the simulator is removed.

pre_p0_gate.en: Finite-state exhaustive truth must expose similar-risk cases with different minimal predecessor constraints and held-out-topology decision differences versus the direct shield.

minimum_p0.en: Use >=40 irreversible failures + 20 matched safe cases held out by topology; freeze clauses and run simulator-off measuring unsafe entries, false blocks, success, and cost.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: irreversible failures and matched safe predecessor states across held-out topologies

economy_contract.effect_observable: simulator-off irreversible-failure prevention and false-block outcome
economy_contract.effect_moderators: topology, state predicate, action type, checkpoint
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: episode failures can hide the necessary predecessor
economy_contract.cheapest_falsifier: finite-state exhaustive truth versus equal-capacity direct shield
economy_contract.decision_changing_outcomes: held-out topology advantage permits P0; equivalence collapses to shielding
economy_contract.abandonment_condition: direct-shield equivalence or no reusable predecessor structure

final_parent_mechanism.en: From same-start successful normal/perturbed pairs extract the earliest recovery state-action residual; write an operator+applicability predicate only after replication across >=2 contexts.

terminal_reason.zh: 缺少人工要求的 exact-state phenomenon artifact：至少 100 对 same-start normal/perturbed success、直接 residual Δs、success-only writer audit 与预注册 prevalence。
terminal_reason.en: Missing the human-required exact-state phenomenon artifact: at least 100 same-start normal/perturbed success pairs, direct residual Delta s, a success-only writer audit, and preregistered prevalence.

exact_stop.en: Stop if residuals do not replicate, or if same-data direct recovery/full-trajectory memory is equivalent at matched budget.

prior_terminal_reason.zh: 缺少人工要求的 exact-state phenomenon artifact：至少 100 对 same-start normal/perturbed success、直接 residual Δs、success-only writer audit 与预注册 prevalence。
prior_terminal_reason.en: Missing the human-required exact-state phenomenon artifact: at least 100 same-start normal/perturbed success pairs, direct residual Delta s, a success-only writer audit, and preregistered prevalence.

revival.changed_assumption: Persist minimal state-conditioned recovery residual operators that must replicate across independent perturbations, not paired-trajectory data or full recovery memory.

strongest_baseline.en: Full recovery-episode memory, nearest trajectory retrieval, same-pair direct conditional recovery policy, and success-only writer with matched memory/tokens/calls.

pre_p0_gate.en: First satisfy >=100 same-start successful pairs with direct state residuals and success-only writer audit; >=20% of pairs must support residual operators reusable across identities/contexts.

minimum_p0.en: After the phenomenon gate freeze 10-20 operators and evaluate simulator-free on held-out perturbation types/scenes for recovery, extra steps, clean interference, and memory cost.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: same-start pairs contain recurrent and non-recurrent recovery residuals

economy_contract.effect_observable: future recovery success and step reduction from a frozen operator
economy_contract.effect_moderators: perturbation type, scene, recovery state, applicability
economy_contract.aggregation_risk: successful episodes can hide one-off residuals
economy_contract.decision_changing_outcomes: recurrent residual support permits P0; lack of recurrence stops
